recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if a future ballot page reintroduces a generated ballot-package inventory whose link labels need artifact-type context.
issue_request: FHIR-17004 was a Published FHIR-core/FHIR-I change request from the 2018 May R4 ballot, section 1.10.5 of ballot-intro.html, asking that each link title in the Normative Ballot Packages section be changed to the form "XXX (type)". The resolution was Persuasive with Modification: "well, ok, if it's possible", and a Jira comment says it had been done.
initial_application: No commit explicitly tagged FHIR-17004 was found. Historical source used a generated [%normative-pages ...%] macro for the affected R4 ballot package lists, and Jira records the request as done, but the exact implementation is not identifiable from a FHIR-17004-tagged commit.
additional_context: The active current ballot-intro.html source is an R6 ballot roadmap with Details of Changes and ballot-process guidance. It is in build scope via publish.ini and source/hierarchy.xml, but it no longer contains the R4 Normative Ballot Packages section or generated link list; that R4-specific section was removed during the R5 ballot-draft rewrite. Current CI output also lacks an equivalent section.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Adding type suffixes to unrelated current R6 links would be broader than the 2018 ballot-page formatting request and would not correct a current source defect.
